snippet.title: F.A.G.E.N. Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Welcome to F.A.G.E.N.

Jump into a chaotic co-op adventure where working together is probably your best option… probably.

Explore strange places, solve your way through unpredictable situations, and try to survive the chaos with your friends.
